verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.hummingbird.co that indexes the help center as markdown links, and help pages are served as .md URLs an agent can read. However, the developer API docs at docs.hummingbird.co, including their llms.txt, are password-gated, and no OpenAPI spec is public. Missing for 10: public agent-readable developer/API reference (llms.txt behind password gate), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.hummingbird.co/llms.txt # Hummingbird Help Center
